description:
A conflict reachable only through `supports`, so carriers carry non-empty paths. This distinguishes a selector reading the graph from one reading adjacency: the derived pair is implicated by the conflict but has no `contradicts` edge of its own.

**Elicited, not typical.** Experiment 3 section 3.4 measured depth-2 propagation in 7 of 20 live runs and warned that one-hop webs are the common case. This fixture deliberately constructs the deeper structure so the mechanism can be characterised at all; any claim about how often it fires belongs to Stage 0's base rate, not here.

expect.note: A carrier whose `path` is non-empty was reached by traversal. If none exists the fixture cannot discriminate a graph query from an adjacency scan.

beliefs.proposition: Services in this estate degrade gracefully under partial outage.
The payments service degrades gracefully when the ledger is unreachable.
Payments queued rather than failing during the ledger outage.
Payments returned errors during the ledger outage.
